run_subprocess_and_check_signal: run a command via subprocess and return 1 if killed by a signal or 0 otherwise
test_break_on_failure_default_behavior: test the default break-on-failure mode with no environment variable or flag set
test_break_on_failure_env_var: test the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable by setting it to 0 or 1
test_break_on_failure_flag: test the --gtest_break_on_failure command line flag with values 0 or 1
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the gtest_break_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable
